promQLQuery.expr: label_replace(max(liq_up{job=~"$source"}) or max(up{job=~"$source",job!="t0-liquidity-exporter"}), "k", "up", "", "") or label_replace(time() - max(liq_bot_start_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$source"}), "k", "uptime", "", "") or label_replace(max by (git_commit) (timestamp(liq_bot_info{job=~"$source"})), "k", "commit", "", "") or label_replace(max by (broker, log_level, wallet_kind, wallet_address, orderbook, turnkey_organization, server_port) (timestamp(liq_settings_info{job=~"$source"})), "k", "info", "", "") or label_replace(max(liq_settings_equity_target{job=~"$source"}), "k", "equity_target", "", "") or label_replace(max(liq_settings_equity_deviation{job=~"$source"}), "k", "equity_deviation", "", "") or label_replace(max(liq_settings_usdc_target{job=~"$source"}), "k", "usdc_target", "", "") or label_replace(max(liq_settings_usdc_deviation{job=~"$source"}), "k", "usdc_deviation", "", "") or label_replace(max(liq_settings_execution_threshold_usd{job=~"$source"}), "k", "trigger", "", "") or label_replace(max(liq_settings_cash_reserved{job=~"$source"}), "k", "cash_reserved", "", "") or label_replace(max(liq_settings_order_polling_seconds{job=~"$source"}), "k", "order_polling", "", "") or label_replace(max(liq_settings_inventory_poll_seconds{job=~"$source"}), "k", "inventory_polling", "", "") or label_replace(max(liq_settings_deployment_block{job=~"$source"}), "k", "deployment_block", "", "")

panels.title: Raindex Orders
panels.description: The SPA's Orders tab, columns in SPA order (Output | Input | Vault Balance | IO Ratio | Order Hash | Created). Shipped by the exporter's collect_orders() as one Cloud Logging row per order per poll cycle (logName liquidity-orders); insertId buckets by poll-hour so a still-active order dedupes to ~1 stored row/hour rather than one per 60s poll — with a 2h window that means a couple of rows per order is expected, not a bug. Created is the order's own on-chain creation time (jsonPayload.created_at), not the row's ingestion time. The datasource returns at most about the panel's pixel width in entries.
Raindex orders owned by the bot (upstream REST API total).
1 when the bot's upstream REST API for Raindex orders is unavailable.
